name: SHL Finance Co.
summary: Saudi Home Loans Company (SHL Finance Co.) specializes in providing real estate financing solutions to individuals throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its services include funding the acquisition of various residential properties, such as houses, land plots, and apartments. The company also offers financial backing for real estate developments undertaken by specialized firms, and supports the establishment of commercial and industrial projects. Founded in 2007, the firm is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
